dct_creator_sm: City of Peterborough Open Data Portal.
dct_description_sm: The City of Peterborough Geomatics/Mapping division maintains the City's parcel fabric in-house. A parcel fabric stores a continuous surface of connected parcels or parcel network. This layer contains Parcel polygons. It is one of the core layers for the City of Peterborough mapping and GIS division.
